title: Second nested pair component
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, define $t_W(z)$ to be the second component of the first component of the defaulted pair decoding of $z$.
caveat: The supplied payload does not define the defaulted pair decoding operation, so its precise mathematical behavior cannot be stated self-containedly.
